findings.comment: Erosion Hazard Zone (EHZ) legend symbol is defined on Sheet 3 (Block 6), but no EHZ boundary is delineated on the storm sewer plan (Sheet 12), drainage area map (Sheet 13), or referenced in the Engineer's Summary Letter. The site is located within the West Bouldin Creek Watershed (64+ acre drainage area). Without geographic confirmation of distance to the creek centerline, it cannot be verified whether the 100-foot proximity trigger applies, nor can compliance with the 20-foot minimum setback requirement be assessed. EHZ analysis per DCM Appendix E Level 1 procedure must be submitted if triggering criteria are met.

applicableAreas: Property lines shared with adjacent SF-3 parcel
findings.comment: Site is within 75 feet of an adjacent SF-3 triggering property (0406100210) and zoned MF-2 (less restrictive), triggering Compatibility Standards under LDC § 25-2-1063(A). The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 references only Subchapter E 2.5 generic site lighting standards and does not demonstrate compliance with the specific requirement that exterior lighting must be hooded or shielded so the light source is not visible from the property line or alleyway shared with the triggering property. A Compatibility Standards exhibit demonstrating shielding at the shared property line is required.

applicableAreas: Property lines shared with adjacent SF-3 parcel
findings.comment: No demonstration of compliance with LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(1) requirement that vehicle lights from vehicles using or parked on site must be screened so as not to be visible from the property line or alleyway shared with the adjacent SF-3 triggering property. Plans do not show vehicle light screening details or Compatibility Standards exhibit addressing this requirement. Screening details at the shared property line must be provided.

codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes for COA
applicableAreas: Exterior lighting notes on site plan
findings.comment: The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 states 'All exterior lighting will be full cut-off and fully shielded in compliance with Subchapter E 2.5' but does not specify that this requirement applies only to new or proposed exterior lighting, not to existing fixtures. General Site Plan Notes for COA require explicit clarification that the standard applies to proposed work only.

codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes for COA
applicableAreas: Exterior lighting notes on site plan
findings.comment: The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 does not specify that it applies within the limits of construction or project-specific boundaries. General Site Plan Notes for COA require the note to clarify the scope and location of applicability to distinguish proposed site improvements from existing conditions outside the project limits.

The cover sheet states Project Area of 2.16 acres but Limits of Construction of 2.26 acres—a difference of 0.1 acres (approximately 4,356 sq ft). The discrepancy is shown numerically on the cover sheet but is not clarified in terms of what constitutes the extended limits (e.g., right-of-way improvements, public utility easements, etc.). A note explaining the extent and purpose of improvements beyond the legal property boundary is required.
